label: PRE_REGISTERED
statement: A4 v2 pre-registers, for the final stage-100 run after the rustls + resource roll, exactly the A4 rules the owner approved at ~14:45Z. It is frozen before that run, bound to the run's runtime identity before load by scripts/p184_a4_preregistered.py bind, and applies to no earlier run. A4 v1 (config/v2/p184-stage100-a4-ts-eligibility.json, POST_HOC_OWNER_DECISION) is unchanged and stays the decision for p184-final-campaign-20261018T123222Z only.

a4_v1.relation: same rules; A4 v1 is post-hoc for 123222Z only and is not edited; its ts_acceptance_bounds and limits_stated are the basis of A4 v2

G2.statistic: new-event transit, venue event -> TS execution Redis APPLY reply (scripts/p184_g2_mark_trace_transit.py)
G2.replaced_rule: max < 1000 ms and p95 <= 500 ms (frozen 2026-10-09, TS upgrade/p184-phase-d-gates.md G2 row: 2x headroom under D3 MARK 2000 ms)
G2.basis: 0.6 x the TS 2000 ms MARK use-time budget (1.67x headroom instead of 2x)
G2.unchanged: p95 limit; every other G2 row (TRADE p95 <= 500 / max < 1500; QUOTE p95 <= 500 / max < 1000; MARK|OKX p95 <= 500 / max < 1000)

G4.statistic: per-window delivery visibility, venue -> canonical (read_committed upper bound), observer v7
G4.p95_rule: the frozen-table rule of the pooled row: per window with n >= 20, FAIL when the p95 bucket lower edge is over the limit; a p95 bucket straddling the limit is unresolved (NOT_MEASURED, never PASS); no window with n >= 20 -> NOT_MEASURED; the pooled limit must equal the frozen budget table value at score time
G4.retention: every window whose max is over the replaced addendum max limit needs observer v7 exceedance retention for the row with threshold_ms <= that limit, overflow 0, admitted_seen == the window n and the window maximum among the retained events; otherwise the row is FAIL (UNKNOWN = FAIL). Every retained event is listed in the rescore receipt.
G4.unchanged: every frozen-table row and its p95 rule, the mark_index_price|OKX_INVERSE| addendum row, every other addendum row, G4-A1, G4-A2, A3 and the window schedule

external_exemption_statement: A4 v2 adds no external exemption: it changes the statistic of three G4 rows and one G2 max limit only. External attribution stays exactly A3 (whichever A3 the campaign recorded and applied).

applies_to.binding_receipt: <campaign_dir>.a4-v2-binding.json (scripts/p184_a4_preregistered.py bind, the launcher's first command, before the guard and p184_gate_campaign.py run)
applies_to.close_receipt: <campaign_dir>.a4-v2-close.json (scripts/p184_a4_preregistered.py close, after the campaign wrote scorecard.json)

runtime_identity_pin.basis: no digest is hard-coded here: the image ids of the final run do not exist at freeze time (rustls + resource roll pending)
runtime_identity_pin.bound_by: the binding receipt records, before the campaign directory exists, docker inspect .Image of every A3 runtime role and the writer (gc.a3_runtime_images()), the writer identity in the preflight runtime_identity shape, and the cgroup caps (NanoCpus, CpuQuota, CpuPeriod, CpusetCpus, Memory, MemorySwap) of the A3 roles, kafka1-3 and the writer
checked_at_score: A4 v2 frozen_at_unix < binding created_unix < campaign started_unix
the A4 v2 file sha256 equals the one the binding recorded
campaign.json runtime_identity and a3_runtime_images (recorded by the campaign preflight) equal the binding's
the close receipt names the binding sha256 and its images and caps equal the binding's (no roll and no cap change during the run; a G11 writer restart keeps image and caps)
runtime_identity_pin.a3_relation: A3 pins hard-coded runtime_images at its own freeze and the campaign preflight refuses other images, so A3 has to be re-frozen for the rolled images before the final run; A4 v2 therefore does not pin the A3 file sha256 and requires only that the campaign applied the A3 it recorded

conditions: the unchanged frozen scorer (scripts/p184_gate_campaign.py, sha256 pinned here and by A3) reproduces the stored scorecard.json, and A3 was applied
G6 PASS and G9 PASS with 0 data-path eligibility losses
the campaign recorded the pinned budget, G4 addendum, G4-A1 and G4-A2 sha256 and the pinned scorer as tool_sha256
every gate other than G2 and G4 byte-identical with and without A4 v2 (checked by the rescore tool)
anything missing or different: A4 v2 is not applied and the stored scorecard.json (strict) is the record
verdict_reporting: every G2/G4 gate of the A4 v2 receipt carries verdict_without_a4 and reason_without_a4; the receipt carries summary_without_a4 and the sha256 of the untouched scorecard.json
unchanged: G1, G3, G5-G14 rules and verdicts
every other G2 and G4 row
the frozen budget, the G4 addendum, G4-A1, G4-A2, A3 and A4 v1 files
the stored scorecard.json of every run
limits_stated: Pre-registered before the final run, but its content was chosen after observing 123222Z (A4 v1 is the post-hoc decision); A4 v2 makes the rule binding for a new run, it is not evidence that the original frozen rule would pass.
G4: the inverse window maximum is report-only; no max limit applies to these three rows under A4 v2.
G2: the split of the MARK BINANCE tail between DL Query and TS writer read scheduling is unknown (A4 v1 limits_stated).
